name: Kiro for iOS
desc: Kiro's iPhone app for starting, watching and approving agent sessions remotely.
desc_zh: Kiro 的 iPhone 应用，用来在离开笔记本时启动、查看并批准智能体会话。
solves: A cloud session stalls waiting on your approval and your laptop is shut; the phone becomes the place you unblock it.
solves_zh: 云端会话卡在等你批准，而笔记本已经合上；手机就成了你解锁它的地方。
best_for: A session finishes a change on your commute and you want to read the diff before you get home.
best_for_zh: 通勤路上会话改完代码，你想在到家前先看一遍 diff 时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — kiro.dev blog feed; channel A App Store listing for Kiro Enterprise）。 form is recorded as web because the taxonomy has no mobile form; the product is a native iOS client. Three modes: chat, spec and autonomy. A separate App Store app, Kiro Enterprise, appeared 2026-11-19 and is an organizational build of the same client, not a new product. 首次公开日期来源：https://kiro.dev/blog/introducing-kiro-for-ios/
